audit_correction_2026_10_22.note: Source correction: this document is Andreas Fuls, Catalog of Indus Signs (2023, self-published, ISBN 979-8-398-42230-6). The literature registry record for this document carries detected_year 2008, which is the ICIT build year, not the book's year. The registry record's bytes are freeze-pinned whole-file by the Spec 057 freeze test, so this correction is recorded here rather than edited into the registry record (see fix_repair_2026-10-22.md in the audit directory); the registry value is superseded by this note.
